'''pointy-eared green dude PPD 16- Agents of the Black Sun (Non-classic)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[pointy-eared green dude]]
* '''Published:''' 13 October 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Lucia's List|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif|label=Agents Of Black Sun}}
* '''Strategy:''' Agents Of Black Sun
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 AOBS dude DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Brought to you in part by...you guys! Here's what we came up with for a competitive AOBS deck. Rate at your own risk! :P

== Strategy ==

As a last minute thing, I added a Naboo Blaster Rifle for Jodo Kast, simply because he can kick with it.

For those of you who know the debate, when creating this deck, you need to decide if you wanna go Blaster Rack (v) or Combat Response. It's interchangeable...we tried to make the deck that way.

Another good way to do have directed this deck would have been to play off of Tatooine and add in Scum and Villiany for some retrieval and even HIGHER forfeit bounty hunters. But that idea was brought up late into the creation of this deck.

I'm sorry it took so long to complete this deck. I hope you enjoy! Thanks to all the guys who cooperated!

PEGD
